name: Elena Koutris
source:
One of the main heroines of this work. She is rescued by Kikutarou while being attacked by goblins.

She falls head over heels for the protagonist thanks to his magic sword. She invites Kikutarou, who has nowhere to go, to join her party.

[From [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc091/index.html]official site[/url]]
